name: @ever-works/google-workspace-connector-plugin
description: Google Workspace connector plugin for Ever Works platform (event-source pull of Drive file changes and Calendar events via the official Google API Node.js clients, including Google Meet recording transcripts, with opt-in historical backfill)

plugin.name: Google Workspace Connector
plugin.description: Google Workspace connector. Event-source pull of Drive file changes and Calendar events via the official Google API Node.js clients, plus Google Meet recording transcripts exported from the Meet Recordings folder, with opt-in historical backfill (backfillDays, max 90).

refreshToken.title: Google OAuth refresh token (drive.readonly + calendar.readonly scopes)

surfaces.title: Surfaces to ingest: drive, calendar, or drive,calendar (default both)

driveFolderIds.title: Drive folder ids to ingest changes from (comma-separated; whole Drive when empty)

calendarIds.title: Calendar ids to ingest events from (comma-separated; defaults to primary)

meetTranscripts.title: Export Google Meet transcript documents into meeting envelopes

backfillDays.title: Historical backfill window in days on first pull (0 = off, max 90)
